final: SELECT a.translink, t.ordertypedist, COUNT(*) AS matched_count, 1.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY t.ordertypedist) AS fraction_of_order_type FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON t.transreg = a.translink WHERE a.peercorr > 0.149 AND t.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.translink, t.ordertypedist ORDER BY fraction_of_order_type DESC LIMIT 10
